notes.title: v1.15
notes.notes:
- Frame rate can be set
- Auto-save support for shopping street progress
- Fixed a bug that caused an extremely rare error to occur during the ending.
- Volume adjustment
- Detailed adjustments around key input
- Adjusted some changes to make them easier to understand
- Load reduction
- Preparation for major update

notes.title: v.1.13
notes.notes:
- Added graphic settings
- Adjusted the appearance of some objects so that they do not unintentionally feel like something is wrong
- Minor visual corrections when something is wrong
- Reduced processing load
- Fixed the collision detection of some objects
- Adjusted the probability of something happening
  This adjustment is aimed mainly at people who have never played like-based games or have little experience playing them
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: v1.12
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to run under certain circumstances
- Adjusted the probability of abnormal occurrences
- Reduced processing load

notes.title: v1.11
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where the ending did not work properly on some screen sizes
- Fixed incorrect screen size notation in settings
- Adjusted probability of anomalies occurring
- Adjusted brightness of some anomalies
- Adjusted some graphics
- Reduced processing load

notes.title: v1.10
notes.notes:
- Adjusted the probability of abnormal occurrences
- Some graphic adjustments
- Reduced processing load

notes.title: v1.09
notes.notes:
- Texture adjustments to roofs (some signs looked like they were floating in the air)
- Review of clock movement (so it doesn't seem like something is wrong)
- Minor corrections to pedestrian walkways

notes.title: v1.08
notes.notes:
- Screen size can be changed
- Cursor can be moved off screen when menu is displayed

notes.title: v1.07
notes.notes:
・Disabled keyboard arrow input
  it was possible to input like WASD, but this may have been the cause of extremely rare bugs
・Minor review of input settings
・Ensure that the endings are not cut off depending on the screen size
・Make it possible to skip endings
・Fixed a bug that caused discovered anomalies to appear in preference to undiscovered anomalies under certain conditions
・Adjusted the range and speed of some anomalies
・Adjusted game volume
・Minor review of the appearance of 10th Avenue
・Other minor fixes

notes.title: v1.06
notes.notes:
・Small changes to the dental clinic icon
・Slightly increased footstep volume (due to sound not being picked up depending on the environment)
・Load reduction support
・Small revisions

notes.title: v1.05
notes.notes:
・If you miss an abnormality, you will return to Shopping Street 0 (to make it easier to check when no abnormality has occurred)
・Changed the way the clock works (so it is less likely to be mistaken for an abnormality)
・Fixed a bug that caused the viewpoint to move strangely when looking directly below
・Fixed a bug that caused unintended behavior when moving forward/backward repeatedly while some incidents were occurring
・Fine adjustments to textures and objects

notes.title: v1.04
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that caused abnormalities to occur at unintended times under certain conditions.

notes.title: v1.03
notes.notes:
・Added signs to prevent getting lost in the fog
・Adjusted timing of some incidents
・Adjusted logic for incidents
・Reduced processing load
・Other minor improvements
